explanation: Changing the last character T to A produces endGene directly, and "AACCGGTA" is in bank.
AACCGGTT -> AACCGGTA -> AAACGGTA, both intermediate/final genes are in bank, so 2 mutations suffice.
AAAAACCC -> AAAACCCC -> AAACCCCC -> AACCCCCC, one character changes at a time and every step is in bank.
